description.value: Milano Coffee is a Vancouver institution founded in 1984 by Italian Master Roaster Francesco Curatolo, bringing three generations of artisan espresso tradition to the West Coast. The Denman Street espresso bar sits at the gateway to Stanley Park and the seawall — one of the most heavily cycled corridors in Metro Vancouver. The roaster has earned 15 gold medals from the International Institute of Coffee Tasters and is known for blending up to 20 origin coffees into its signature espressos, with outdoor seating available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (12 spaces, covered) at 56m; stands (6 spaces) at 69m. Total: 18 spaces.
